The note is incorrect: adenine nucleotide (ADP/AMP) breakdown is cleared through purine catabolism (AMP → IMP → inosine → hypoxanthine → xanthine → uric acid), not the urea cycle or creatine pathway. During multiple sprint sports, blood concentrations of hypoxanthine and uric acid rise (with ammonia also increasing), reflecting this purine degradation.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
